title: [ARKNIGHTS X MONSTER HUNTER] SIDE STORY: A FLURRY TO THE FLAME OPEN
lines: 01 [ARKNIGHTS X MONSTER HUNTER] SIDE STORY: A FLURRY TO THE FLAME OPEN
EVENT DURATION: September 7, 2023, 10:00 - September 28, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: A Flurry to the Flame event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming them from the Event Store, [Arts Melder].
EVENT STAGES DURATION: Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
- [Soubo Mountains] Duration: September 7, 2023, 10:00 - September 21, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- [Commeowssion Counter] Duration: September 14, 2023, 16:00 - September 21, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Roka Village Quest Board]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Roka Village Quest Board] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★: Terra Research Commission, Module Materials, Melding Materials, etc.
[Arts Melder]
DURATION: September 7, 2023, 10:00 - September 28, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Melding Materials by clearing event stages and Roka Village Quest Board missions. Melding Materials can be used to get rewards from the [Arts Melder].
MAIN REWARDS: Terra Research Commission's Tokens, Momiji Hotel Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permits, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Parts, etc.
02 [ARKNIGHTS X MONSTER HUNTER] LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN - SHARPENED BY FLAME
DURATION: September 7, 2023, 10:00 - September 21, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Sharpened By Flame], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Kirin R Yato
★★★★★: Rathalos S Noir Corne
NOTE:
- This headhunting is a [Triumphant Hunt Headhunting]
- Operators Kirin R Yato and Rathalos S Noir Corne are currently ONLY available from the Limited Headhunting, [Triumphant Hunt Headhunting], and are NOT available in any Standard Headhuntings.
- Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.
03 [ARKNIGHTS X MONSTER HUNTER] SHARPENED BY FLAME LIMITED-TIME LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: September 7, 2023, 10:00 - September 21, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Log in during the event to claim the reward on the event page: Scouting the Light Headhunting Permit x 1
NOTE:
- The Scouting the Light Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform a 10-roll in the [Sharpened By Flame] Limited Headhunting.
- Each account can only claim this reward once during the event.
- The Scouting the Light Headhunting Permit expires at: September 21, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
04 [ARKNIGHTS X MONSTER HUNTER] NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE
DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the game.
★★★★★★: Kirin R Yato
★★★★★: Rathalos S Noir Corne
★: Terra Research Commission
NOTE:
- The Operator Terra Research Commission can currently ONLY be obtained from the event A Flurry to the Flame, and is NOT available in [Sharpened By Flame] or any Standard Headhuntings.
- Operators Kirin R Yato and Rathalos S Noir Corne are currently ONLY available from the Limited Headhunting [Triumphant Hunt Headhunting], and are NOT available in any Standard Headhuntings.
- Operators Kirin R Yato, Rathalos S Noir Corne, and Terra Research Commission will gain more trust in the event stages.
05 [ARKNIGHTS X MONSTER HUNTER] CROSSOVER
& EPOQUE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: September 7, 2023, 10:00 - September 21, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- CROSSOVER Collection - Fly Into the Street for Terra Research Commission
NOTE:
You cannot use an [Outfit Voucher] to redeem this outfit.
- EPOQUE Collection - Yukibare for Suzuran
- EPOQUE Collection - Tsukiyoi for Mint
- EPOQUE Collection - Betsushi for Scene
06 RAYTHEAN STRIKER SERIES RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: September 7, 2023, 10:00 - September 21, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- Raythean Striker Series - Skyline for Schwarz
- Raythean Striker Series - Overload for Liskarm
07 PACKS AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED TIME
DURATION: September 7, 2023, 10:00 - September 28, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
[Roka Voyager Memorial Pack]
CONTENTS: Orundum x 600, Icon 'Fireseeking Leaves' x 1
[Soubo Mountains Research Pack]
CONTENTS: Originite Prime x 13, Headhunting Permit x 1, Keton Colloid x 6, and Crystalline Component x 11.
[Village Construction Funding Box]
CONTENTS: Originite Prime x 16, LMD x 700000
[Hunters' Expedition Pack]
CONTENTS: Originite Prime x 24, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit x 2, LMD x 60000, Strategic Battle Record x 20, Data Supplement Stick x 20
08 CHIP PACKS AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED TIME
[Sharpened By Flame Chip Pack]
DURATION: September 7, 2023, 10:00 - September 21, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: Specialist Dualchip x 4, Specialist Chip x 5, Skill Summary - 3 x 45, Skill Summary - 2 x 25, Skill Summary - 1 x 10.
09 SURPRISEFUL SUPPLICATIONS LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: September 7, 2023, 10:00 - September 21, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, the total amount of event rewards that players can obtain by flipping the Prayer Plaque is the same, including: Event Exclusive Furniture, Module Materials, etc. Flip over all Prayer Plaques to obtain the Icon 'Soubo Impressions' and a [Collaboration Limited Ten-roll Headhunting Permit].

- During the event, players can obtain a flip chance by logging in for the first time each day. At the same time, the first daily flip also has a chance to win extra lucky flip chances. Consecutive daily first flips for two days will trigger a lucky flip.
- Flip chance will reset at 04:00 every day and cannot be accumulated.
- The Collaboration Limited Ten-roll Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform a 10-roll in the [Sharpened By Flame] Limited Headhunting.
- The Collaboration Limited Ten-roll Headhunting Permit expires at: September 21, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
10 NEW FURNITURE SET – MOMIJI HOTEL
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Momiji Hotel, will be available during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- A Flurry to the Flame event rewards, and redeemable from the Roka Village Quest Board (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces): September 7, 2023, 10:00 - September 21, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
For more event details, please stay tuned for the in-game announcements and official notices by Arknights.
